title: appointments.recurring.materialize
description: Books the occurrences of ONE recurring template. Since appointments#54 the template is loaded by id through the authoritative read `appointments.recurring.get` — it used to arrive whole in the payload, names and price included, so the browser wrote who every occurrence of a series was for and what it cost. The three ids still travel here because `reads.params` can only filter by a top-level `payload.<field>`, but they are a SELECTOR: the handler refuses (`appointments.recurring_mismatch`) when they do not match the template the runtime loaded, and the snapshot is frozen from customers/services/staff exactly as `create` does.

recurring_id.description: The recurring template to materialize. Everything about the repetition (frequency, day, time, duration, start/end date, max occurrences) comes from its row, never from here.

from.description: Start of the window to materialize (YYYY-MM-DD, default: today). Never earlier than today.

to.description: End of the window (YYYY-MM-DD, default: from + the hub's own max_advance_booking).

existing_appointments.description: Overlap fallback: candidate appointments of the window. A series spans several days and `reads.params` cannot express «the appointments of each of these days», so the authoritative overlap read of `create` (appointments.appointments.conflicting, filtered by one start) does not fit here yet.
